design: Hero (desktop/frame-00.png): replace the lavender-to-white gradient fill on the H1 with solid white, and replace the violet-to-blue diagonal gradient with one flat brand colour or a single photograph so the first frame has a point of view.
Type: load one display family and one text family (manifest shows Arial only) and set a scale with distinct display (H1), heading (H2), label (card H3) and body sizes held at both widths.

Card rows (desktop/frame-01.png, frame-02.png): vary the module between sections, e.g. a two-column feature list with a product image for Our Features and a single wide quote for testimonials, instead of the same three-card row three times.
Replace the six emoji icons and three star emoji with a drawn icon set at one stroke weight, and give Trusted by Thousands the same subtitle line the other two sections have.
usability: Mobile header (mobile/frame-00.png): collapse the five links behind a labelled menu button below about 768 px, or wrap them to a second row; 'About' is clipped and 'Contact' is unreachable at 390 px.
Hero H1: use a solid white fill so contrast on the violet side of the gradient matches the subhead.
Give the nav links and both CTAs visible destinations (anchors to the matching sections, a real sign-up route) so the labelled controls lead somewhere.
creativity: Choose one concept tied to 'the future of work' and carry it through copy, layout and one authored motion idea (for example a pinned scroll sequence showing the product), rather than the stock hero-cards-cards-testimonials-CTA sequence.
Add one signature moment in the first viewport (a considered reveal, a distinctive menu or hover) so there is an interaction a visitor would remember; the manifest records no motion at all.
Replace the three-emoji-card module with an element that is specific to the product (a live screenshot, a diagram of the workflow) so the layout could not be re-skinned onto another brand.
content: Why Choose Us cards: replace the three identical lorem ipsum bodies with one specific sentence each (what is fast, what is secured, what the power is measured by).
Testimonials: replace '"Amazing!"', '"Love it!"', '"Wow!"' with named customers (company, role) and one concrete outcome each, or remove the section until real quotes exist.
Hero and section leads: replace 'Unlock your potential', 'seamless solutions' and 'Everything you need to succeed' with a one-line statement of what Nexora does and for whom.
Add real imagery: at least one product screenshot or art-directed image in the hero and one per feature; the page currently has zero images and emoji in the image role.
